title: [AUG-39] Live Transcription Mode — real-time Them + Me transcript during recording
why_we_need_this:
Currently August only transcribes after recording stops. Users in live meetings need to see what the other party is saying in real time — for note-taking, catching missed words, and following conversations in non-native languages. This adds a second recording mode that streams system audio through whisper.cpp during the call, displaying a live transcript without changing the existing recording + post-recording pipeline.

You can use how-to-realtime-transcr.md in the project directory to guide you
acceptance_criteria:
## Mode Selection
- Pressing the blue Record button shows a popover with two options: "Default (simple transcription)" and "Live Transcription"
- Selecting either option starts the recording immediately
- "Default" behaves exactly as today — no behavior change

## Live Transcription Engine (macOS only)
- System audio (Them track) is buffered into 3–5 second chunks and fed to whisper.cpp sequentially during recording
- Chunks overlap by ~1 second to preserve context at sentence boundaries
- VAD-gated chunking: silent segments (below existing silenceRMSThreshold) are skipped — no GPU wasted on silence
- Target latency: transcribed text appears within ≤5 seconds of speech
- Both audio files (mic.wav, system.wav) continue recording exactly as in Default mode — the existing recording pipeline is untouched
- Post-recording TranscriptionPipeline still runs as usual after stop, producing the final transcript.md

## Live Transcript UI
- A right-side slide-out panel appears when Live Transcription mode starts, spanning the full height of the app window
- Panel contains a scrollable text view showing live-transcribed text from the Them track
- Auto-scroll: panel auto-scrolls to the latest text; if the user scrolls up manually, auto-scroll pauses; a "↓" button appears to jump back to live
- "Copy All" button copies the entire current live transcript to clipboard
- Text in the panel is selectable via standard macOS text selection
- Panel closes when recording stops

## Resilience
- Pause/resume: user can pause live transcription without stopping the recording; visual indicator shows paused state
- Error isolation: if the live whisper.cpp instance crashes or errors mid-session, recording continues uninterrupted; the panel shows a warning (e.g. "⚠️ Live transcription interrupted") instead of killing the session
- The live transcription whisper instance must not interfere with the post-recording TranscriptionPipeline (separate context/resources)
important_constraints: Scope change (2026-08-28): the live panel shows BOTH tracks, interleaved as `Them: text` / `Me: text` (consecutive same-speaker segments coalesced into one line). "Me" comes from a second, independent AVAudioEngine mic tap (`LiveMicAudioTap`); `MicRecorder` stays untouched. Mic-tap failure degrades to Them-only with a panel notice, never interrupts live mode or the recording.
